notes.title: Tiny little patch for some freshness to the game!
notes.content:
Although our small team is currently working on developing a new game, our commitment with our previous games is still here and so we bring you a new tiny patch to offer some minor improvements to A Gummy's Life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/00c0d9158ba047185a665931202c700982e505d3.png
It might not look like much, but pay attention to the following list of
Fixes and Improvements:

 Improved network code to reduce latency, memory management and synchronization time
 Your gummy character will turn towards the target when there's no input, so hitting your opponents effectively will be much easier. You asked for it, here you have it!
 Improved screen settings behavior with more than one screen
 Fixed an overpowered climbable wall in Arigatothewater map
 A new profile will be created automatically when you open the game the first time with your Steam user (you can still change it afterwards, but we make sure you start collecting stats from the beginning!)

Soon to come...
And that's not all, folks. Our gummies wardrobe of cool hats and glasses will be gone soon. A full new set of cosmetics will be available before this year ends. 
Have you collected all your favorites so far? If not, go on and engage in online matchmaking battles to get those you're missing. They'll be gone soon!

We hope you guys have fun with friends and family playing A Gummy's Life <3 That's why we developed this game and you make us truly happy when you write to us to say things of the sort.

If you find any issues, remember you can always reach us on our social media (Twitter, Instagram or Facebook) or go to the discussion forums. You can also join us on Discord or schedule a match with someone from your region ;)

In case you didn't know, the other game we are currently developing is an online coop adventure game called Oppidum and we've also got its own Discord server opened  

See you soon!
EP Games Team

notes.title: The spookiest patch is here!
notes.content:
It's been a while since we brought you the Altar update, and, while we haven't stopped bringing you awesome events and celebrations, we've also been working very hard to be able to bring you a brand new patch with some special spooky features, just in time to celebrate the creepiest time of the year! Hope you like them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/14247fd095e4c4d81fdf9d5035f22990410f167f.png

Some issues we fixed!

 Randomized gummies used to lose their cosmetics before the game, now they will stay glued on unless your gummy gets hit too hard.
 Gummies' feet used to bug on BeeCareful tiles, stopping the floor from falling, but all gummies are now doomed to fall.
 Scores for King of the Hill mode when playing online with 3 or more players showed the wrong number, for this patch we've learned to count.
 After dying online in Grousky, controllers would keep vibrating even after the player's death, we've gone a more eco-friendly route and we've decided to make it stop, to save energy.

New additions to the game!

 Bored of dying the first in every match and just watching? Don't worry! Enable the new option "Afterlife" in your match customization (local or private) and improve your abilities while your friends keep fighting for victory! After you die in a match, your gummy will still appear as a playable character in the map in the form of a ghost! Spook everyone with your abilities!
 On another note, for those looking for a bigger challenge, how about using a ball or a barrel to get a point? Join a match in King of The Hill mode and throw one of the items into a marshmallow for a point, now with style! 
 Also, gummies' juices splattered onto cars will start falling slowly, instead of disappearing, little by little, for some dramatic added effects!
 And, finally, a fun surprise: when an AI wins a match, if any cosmetics are left around the battlefield, it will try to pick them up and equip them!

We hope you guys have been enjoying the game lately and keep doing so with these new cool features and fixes! If you find any issues, remember you can always reach us on our social media ( Twitter ,  Instagram  or  Facebook ) or go to the  discussion forums . You can also join us on  Discord  to talk about the game or schedule a match with someone from your region ;)

Also remember that your reviews are very important to us and help us a lot! ❤  See you playing!

 EP Games Team

notes.title: The sweetest anniversary is here!
notes.content:
Saturday, 24th September is a day to celebrate in A Gummy's Life!
Even though the game was out earlier on Steam and Nintendo Switch, last year we launched A Gummy's Life on Xbox and PlayStation consoles, enabling cross-play between all of them! It's been a year since then and we've been sharing many memories and updates together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/fbdcbf5a8df998449d68433f735bbb0248a33349.png

In one year, we've released 4 updates, including: adding cosmetics to the game, 4 new maps, 2 new gummies, AIs learning to drive, full rework of the grabbing system, improvements in the UI to show more info about the game modes, customization of Private Online matches, pinging system to find yourself on the screen, and a whole new seasonal wardrobe change!

To commemorate such a milestone, we introduce you to: a weekend-long event! 
From Thursday 22nd to Sunday 25th, join online matches in A Gummy's Life to celebrate with us and get those cosmetics you've been missing for so long! 

Say hi to all of the limited-time and holiday cosmetics we've brought so far, cause they are back! 
When we originally released these items, we did so for no longer than a week, to enjoy holidays and festivities in a different way. Now, we’ve decided to bring them back once more so you all have the opportunity to get them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/75396a91dbf7e13e37b572f378584d19e03cdf6d.png

Plus, a party would not be a party if not for some pixel sunglasses and party hats! Since we knew they were pretty loved and give off party vibes like no other in-game item, we thought that they were the perfect fit for this kind of celebration, so, for a few days, they’ll be available again to unlock.

Finally, a completely new and special cosmetic is waiting for you: a royal crown! Flaunt the shiniest of looks in the most amazing way to show that you got to celebrate this first anniversary! And, who knows? Maybe in a few years you can also use it to prove how long you've been with us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/021870f4ef00ed19ea05761a31f49d4d3ed2708b.png

We're quite a tiny team and don't get many opportunities to say Thank you, so hope you feel this event as a warm hug from us to our lovely community. 

Plus, this week A Gummy's Life is on sale! Tell your friends ^^

https://store.steampowered.com/app/585190/A_Gummys_Life/

See you guys soon wearing all that lovely royal crown!
Happy one year with us! 

If you'd like to celebrate some more, join us on Discord and ask us anything. 

If you want to see something new, follow us on Twitter, we're working on a new game! :D

Now, the way to get the new hats and glasses available remains unchanged from old ways, but a small reminder for anyone who might feel lost!:

 Join a game in online matchmaking, where you'll be paired with random players available at the moment
 Enjoy your game until the end (we recommend you try to win)

So, if you want to get every single new look for every gummy, you'd better get playing. 
 
What are you waiting for? Get winning and start showing off in fashion! Good luck!

notes.title: Get in on the sweetest mayhem!
notes.content:
A Gummy's Life is taking part in this year's remote play together once again!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/da2c9d0dcd4d8e5f33b62bd90e660fddd4ad8e7c.png

A Gummy's life is a brawler-type game where you'll be fighting other gummies for the win. The game offers a great variety of maps, each of them with their own special characteristics, and many hazards on your way to victory, so be careful! You can also choose and customize your character to your liking, and take it to battle in any of the 4 different game modes available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/73e8c4cc139e25e7cd0580bf91578b93288eeb17.gif

If you're in the mood of playing by yourself, you can try online matchmaking or play locally against AI's with different levels of difficulty, but if you want to play with friends, you can choose to play local multiplayer or try private online matches, whatever best suits your needs, especially now that our most recent update offers the possibility to customize private online matches with almost as much freedom as local multiplayer.

When playing online, the game also supports crossplay, so you can share the game with anyone, no matter where they play. It also supports up to eight players per game, so nobody gets left out! 

Lastly if you play on pc, no matter if you’d rather play with your keyboard or your controller, the game supports both mediums, so choose your weapon wisely. Create the perfect strategy to win, or smash buttons on your way to victory and prove once and for all that you are the strongest player!

Check out our social media for more information and updates about the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/585190/A_Gummys_Life/

Hope you enjoy as much as we did while developing it for you! 

Remember that your reviews help us a lot & you can always reach us on Discord, Twitter, Instagram or the discussion forums for any doubts or feedback :D

- Cross Play with PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S is now available
- Cosmetics! Different hats and glasses have been added for each of your gummies to keep fighting crazily, but stylish! You'll be able to unlock them by playing online (matchmaking)

- 2 new unlockable gummies
- New unlockable difficulty mode

- Improved movements of Plank and Tackle to be faster and smoother
- The hexagons in BeeCareful will recover its original color much slower now after being stepped on
- You can now pass the potato by driving through another gummy with the tractor in Hot Potato mode

- In Robox, the sugar splats on the belts will now move with them
- The AIs will now choose more varied colors for their gummies

Today we bring you a new patch with important fixes to improve your online experience!

Fixes:
AIs used to take control over the player's gummy in rare cases of a bit of lag detected; we have a system to ensure other players can still play if one loses connection, but hey, a bit of lag should not make you lose your character!

Gummies would get stuck in the online hub if they got out & in of a game very quickly; we explained to them how agile humans are and they'll handle it better from now on.

Sudden death after a draw at the end of an online game was not working, but there can only be one champion!

Remaping the keyboard controls was not working properly.

notes.title: Ready for some crazy physics-based gameplay?
notes.content:
A demo of A Gummy's Life will be running along the weekend to celebrate Steam Remote Play Together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/a61be05a7978e75bbc347c63d83c7a0e1289d46d.png

Get A Gummy's Life and enjoy its crazy multiplayer physics-based fights with your friends. 

In a Gummy's Life you can find:

Fully featured Online multiplayer up to 8 players, cross-play with Nintendo Switch®!
Play as a gummy with up to 16 Friends in your couch and up to 8 in online mode.

Easy to play, hard to master
You can sit down, smash all the buttons and have fun or... use the right move in each situation to take your opponents down!

Different game modes
Hot Potato, King of the Hill, Team Deathmatch... The fun doesn't stop on the classic Free for All mode.

Full controller and keyboard support
The most common controllers are supported out of the box. You can also create a profile and customize your control layout. Keyboard and mouse are also supported (one player can play with keyboard and mouse). Altough, we recommend a gamepad :D

Tons of levels to play with different game style and mechanics
You'll find something new in each level. Each one has a different way to be played. Have fun discovering all their secrets!

Lots of different gummies to play with
Each of them has slightly different stats. You can choose between many different colors and there are also unlockable gummies!

notes.title: A Gummy's Life 0.9 - Now with Online multiplayer!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27765963/aae6653da09663c83688cbc83a8598c746c111ee.png
Hello! the time has come. Online multiplayer has arrived to A Gummy's Life.

Fellow A Gummy's Life players, we are proud to announce that Online multiplayer is here.

	Many of you were asking since the early access release that we should add online multiplayer to A Gummy's Life, we wanted to do it as well but since it's a physics-based game, making it work with no problems it's hard. But it's here, it works, IT'S FUN, trust us.
	
	Currently there's only Deathmatch mode and 8 levels. We will be adding more levels in the following weeks. 
	
	To play it you just have to press the big Online button in the main menu. We have replaced the training button, which is now available in the top right corner of the main menu.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27765963/d77d06c686e70293fc80b1f73a98b5af9ba61974.png

Patch notes:

	Added Online multiplayer. 
	Added TheRolling to the online mode.
	Several fixes in the online mode based on the online beta feedback.
	Added a ping restriction when connecting to Online multiplayer.
	Added ping lock in the online mode (To prevent people with high ping to disturb other people games)
	If a player disconnects mid-game in online multiplayer it will become an AI.
	If the master host leaves the game, other player may become the new host (The current level will reset)
	Upgraded the game engine version.
	Big improvements on how the game controls are shown to the player.
    Revised the anticipation times of several attacks, everything should be faster now.
    Overall improvements in the controls.
    AI now is able to grab and throw you.
	Added hit particles to improve the hitting feeling.
	Various AI improvements.
    Various UI animation improvements.
    First profile is now autoselected when selecting a character.
    Added more robots in Robox.
	King of Hill gummy roll can no longer appear over obstacles.
	Robox updated. Doors will now open when there's an knock-out gummy close, and doors will now absorb you instead of making you explode (you still die :P).
	Fixed the camera on Training sometimes flying away.
	Various improvements in how the gummies behave when the buildings go up in Grousky.
	Black fog bug on Arigatothewater is now fixed! yay! 
	And as always more little bug fixes that may be unnoticed by you, but not to us :)

Bring your friends from all over the world and come join the fun.

We hope you guys like it.
Enjoy and don't forget to let your thoughts on the discussion forums!

We also created a Discord server for you to join! Click here https://discord.gg/v59R56q to join the community and help us grow!

notes.title: A Gummy's Life 0.90beta - Online beta is here!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27765963/d77d06c686e70293fc80b1f73a98b5af9ba61974.png

Hello! the Online beta is here, come help us improve it by participating :D

Fellow A Gummy's Life players, the time has come. After a few months developing it, we are ready to release the first beta of the Online multiplayer version of A Gummy's Life.

How to Opt-in?
	Since this is a beta release you need to enter this code: "AGLO20182018" into the beta's tab, to do so follow this steps:

	Right click A Gummy's Life on Steam > Properties > Beta tab > Add code in the field > Select "onlinebeta" in the dropdown > Accept and download the new version!
	
Beta? What does this mean?
	Since making online multiplayer for this physics-based action game is very hard, we want to reach the end users with the best version that we can deliver them.
	This mean that the current state is a Beta version where we would be hearing your thoughts and feedback to improve this version before releasing it to everyone.
	
How can we, the users. help you?
	We would love to hear your feedback in our discussion forums, call your friends, test everything, break it if you can, but tell us how, we'll fix it, we promise.

What is included in the online beta?
	Currently there's only Deathmatch mode and 7 levels, we will be adding more levels in the following weeks. 
	Everything else is the same.

We also created a Discord server for you to join!
	Click here https://discord.gg/v59R56q to join the community and help us grow!  

	
Now with some patch notes:

	Added Online beta. 
    Revised the anticipation times of several attacks, everything should be faster now.
    Overall improvements in the controls.
    AI now is able to grab and throw you.
	Added hit particles to improve the hitting feeling.
	Various AI improvements.

    First profile is now autoselected when selecting a character.
    Added more robots in Robox.
	King of Hill gummy roll can no longer appear over obstacles.

	And as always more little bug fixes that may or may not be noticed by you, but we see them! :)

Hot Potato - It's hot, it's coming, pass the hot potato between your enemies so they explode, the last one standing wins!

  
  2 New levels!

Robox - Escape the robots coming for you, fight with the boxes, don't let the conveyor belts get you!
Grousky - To the sky they say, fight and run, don't fall!

	
2 New unlockable characters, the Burger and the Cherry.

With the new way to unlock them, a new challenger aproaches! Fight the Big Gummy to unlock it, will you be able to defeat it?


A Gummy's Life now supports 6 new languages 

Simplified Chinnese
Japanese
Russian
German
French.
and Portuguese!


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27765963/98c5e27a1b74d6c9bbe6fee16237364568468ca0.png

	Make fun on your opponents with the new taunt system, use your arrows/d-pad to use them!


Dab, Clap, Show your strenght or even thank your viewers for watching your show!

	Levels will not appear twice in a row anymore if there's more selected in the map selection.
And as always more underground fixes that will make the game feel more polished.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27765963/417d46f4910605559f8815c3131e124adb212748.png

Thank you for your patience and we hope you guys like it.
Enjoy and don't forget to let your thoughts on the discussion forums!

notes.title: A Gummy's Life - The Splat Patch!
notes.content:
Hello! Today we are updating A Gummy's Life with a ton of new improvements!

    New Juice Splat system.
    New profile system so you can customize the name and controls for you and your friends (Select your profile in the selection screen with RB - LB)
    Improved the lift system.
    Soften and improved character movements.
    Visual and vibration improvements when hitting other characters.
    Improved punch system and aiming.
    The AI now has unique names and are shown on the scoreboard.
    You can enable/disable XInput in the options.
    You can now turn off the announcer voice.
    New option avalaible to end the game when there is only AI left.
    Added missing sounds in some levels.
    Overall improvements on the feel and gameplay.
    Enabled cloud saving.


We hope you guys like it.
Enjoy and don't forget to let your thoughts on the discussion forums!
